<reason>Both sides were sharp, disciplined, and answered pressure questions in the required format. CON built the cleaner single attack — the discretion dilemma and the "shrinkage" narrative that PRO's right collapses into ordinary burden-shifted appeals — and pressed it consistently. But PRO won the decisive exchanges. First, PRO's distinction between random noise and systematic bias was explicitly conceded by CON ("yes, averaging stabilizes bias"), gutting CON's "thousands of outliers cancel out" defense of the instrument. Second, PRO turned CON's own admission that completion rates punish drivers who cancel on threatening passengers into evidence that metrics pricing submission are unjust. Third, and most damaging, CON's own remedy list (strike tainted ratings, telemetry, safety-carved completion rates, "she keeps her job on the cleaned record") concedes the outcome the motion demands, which simultaneously defuses the two-tier-market harm — since CON supplies the checkable alternatives that keep bad workers visible. CON's escape was a maximalist textual reading ("a standing exit from being measured"), but the motion's own qualifier, "strongly shaped by abuse, bias, or harassment," makes PRO's conditional reading at least as natural, and PRO was conditional from its opening [A1.5], so the alleged retreat was overstated. PRO also converted the residual gap into a real policy difference — entitlement with the burden on the platform versus a discretionary program the platform may decline — which CON answered only with the assertion that rhetoric about ownership is empty. CON's underexploited best line, that the exit is "as wide as enforcement is weak," was its strongest live route but stayed speculative. Both sides mis-cited nonexistent [C2.x] IDs; both openings were clipped; those costs wash.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>PRO's Pressure Question forcing CON to name the metric by which a driver who ends a ride after being groped can be judged. CON's honest answer — telemetry, safety-carved completion rates, "she keeps her job on the cleaned record" — simultaneously conceded the motion's outcome and supplied PRO's alternative metrics, collapsing CON's two-tier-market harm. PRO's closing crystallized this as agreement on outcome with disagreement only over who owns the remedy.</best_rebuttal>
